article_context: 文章围绕“买房是否该让孩子参与决策”汇集心理学家、地产经纪、律师和分析师的不同意见：让孩子有参与感有益，但最终决策仍应由成年人根据长期需求和财务现实作出。语气应像生活方式报道，轻松、清晰，人物引语保持自然。

article.title: 阅读 Part B · 买房时孩子的意见该有多大分量
article.background: 文章围绕“买房是否该让孩子参与决策”汇集心理学家、地产经纪、律师和分析师的不同意见：让孩子有参与感有益，但最终决策仍应由成年人根据长期需求和财务现实作出。语气应像生活方式报道，轻松、清晰，人物引语保持自然。

sentences.en: In choosing a new home, Camille McClain's kids have a single demand: a backyard.
sentences.zh: 在挑选新家时，卡米尔·麦克莱恩的孩子们只有一个要求：要有后院。

segments.text: In choosing a new home, Camille McClain's kids have a single demand: a backyard.

sentences.en: McClain's little ones aren't the only kids who have an opinion when it comes to housing, and in many cases youngsters' views weigh heavily on parents' real estate decisions, according to a 2018 Harris Poll survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults.
sentences.zh: 麦克莱恩家的孩子并非唯一会对住房发表意见的孩子；2018年哈里斯民调对2000多名美国成年人进行调查后发现，在很多情况下，孩子的看法会对父母的房地产决策产生很大影响。

segments.text: McClain's little ones aren't the only kids who have an opinion when it comes to housing, and in many cases youngsters' views weigh heavily on parents' real estate decisions, according to a 2018 Harris Poll survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults.

sentences.en: While more families buck an older-generation proclivity to leave kids in the dark about real estate decisions, realty agents and psychologists have mixed views about the financial, personal and long-term effects kids' opinions may have.
sentences.zh: 越来越多家庭正在打破老一代在房产决策中不让孩子知情的倾向，但房地产经纪人和心理学家对孩子的意见可能带来的财务、个人和长期影响看法不一。

segments.text: While more families buck an older-generation proclivity to leave kids in the dark about real estate decisions, realty agents and psychologists have mixed views about the financial, personal and long-term effects kids' opinions may have.

sentences.en: The idea of involving children in a big decision is a great idea because it can help them feel a sense of control and ownership in what can be an overwhelming process, said Ryan Hooper, clinical psychologist in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥临床心理学家瑞安·胡珀说，让孩子参与一项重大决定是个好主意，因为这能帮助他们在一个可能令人无所适从的过程中获得掌控感和主人翁意识。

segments.text: The idea of involving children in a big decision is a great idea because it can help them feel a sense of control and ownership in what can be an overwhelming process, said Ryan Hooper, clinical psychologist in Chicago.

sentences.en: "Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“孩子如果面临一次重大变动，在适应过程中可能会遇到严重困难，尤其是当这使他们离开目前的学校或支持体系时。”

segments.text: "Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system," he said.

sentences.en: Greg Jaroszewski, real estate broker with Gagliardo Realty Associates, said he's not convinced that kids should be involved in selecting a home - but their opinions should be considered in regards to proximity to friends and social activities, if possible.
sentences.zh: 在加利亚多房地产联合公司任经纪人的格雷格·雅罗舍夫斯基说，他不认为孩子该参与选房，但如果可能，也应考虑他们离朋友和社交活动地点有多近。

vocab.meaning: 离朋友和社交活动地点有多近

segments.text: Greg Jaroszewski, real estate broker with Gagliardo Realty Associates, said he's not convinced that kids should be involved in selecting a home - but their opinions should be considered in regards to proximity to friends and social activities, if possible.

sentences.en: Younger children should feel like they're choosing their home - without actually getting a choice in the matter, said Adam Bailey, real estate attorney based in New York.
sentences.zh: 纽约房地产律师亚当·贝利说，应该让年幼的孩子感觉自己正在选择新家——实际上却不真正把决定权交给他们。

segments.text: Younger children should feel like they're choosing their home - without actually getting a choice in the matter, said Adam Bailey, real estate attorney based in New York.

sentences.en: Asking them questions about what they like about the backyard of a potential home will make them feel like they're being included in the decision-making process, Bailey said.
sentences.zh: 贝利说，可以问问他们喜欢备选房屋后院的哪些地方，这会让他们觉得自己被纳入了决策过程。

segments.text: Asking them questions about what they like about the backyard of a potential home will make them feel like they're being included in the decision-making process, Bailey said.

sentences.en: Many of the aspects of homebuying aren't a consideration for children, said Tracey Hampson, a real estate agent based in Santa Clarita, Calif.
sentences.zh: 加州圣克拉丽塔的房地产经纪人特蕾西·汉普森说，买房时考虑的很多因素，孩子其实并不会考虑。

segments.text: Many of the aspects of homebuying aren't a consideration for children, said Tracey Hampson, a real estate agent based in Santa Clarita, Calif.

sentences.en: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.
sentences.zh: 而过分看重他们的意见，可能会毁掉一次原本很棒的购房。

segments.text: And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase.

sentences.en: "Speaking with your children before you make a real estate decision is wise, but I wouldn't base the purchasing decision solely on their opinions." Hampson said.
sentences.zh: 汉普森说：“做房地产决定前和孩子谈一谈是明智的，但我不会仅凭他们的意见决定是否购买。”

segments.text: "Speaking with your children before you make a real estate decision is wise, but I wouldn't base the purchasing decision solely on their opinions." Hampson said.

sentences.en: The other issue is that many children - especially older ones - may base their real estate knowledge on HGTV shows, said Aaron Norris of The Norris Group in Riverside, Calif.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，许多孩子——尤其是年龄较大的孩子——可能会根据HGTV节目来形成自己的房地产认知，来自加州河滨市诺里斯集团的亚伦·诺里斯说。

segments.text: The other issue is that many children - especially older ones - may base their real estate knowledge on HGTV shows, said Aaron Norris of The Norris Group in Riverside, Calif.

sentences.en: "They love Chip and Joanna Gaines just as much as the rest of us," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“他们和我们其他人一样喜欢奇普和乔安娜·盖恩斯。”

segments.text: "They love Chip and Joanna Gaines just as much as the rest of us," he said.

sentences.en: "HGTV has seriously changed how people view real estate.
sentences.zh: “HGTV已经严重改变了人们看待房地产的方式。

segments.text: "HGTV has seriously changed how people view real estate.

sentences.en: It's not shelter, it's a lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 它不再只是遮风避雨的住所，而是一种生活方式。

segments.text: It's not shelter, it's a lifestyle.

sentences.en: With that mindset change come some serious money consequences."
sentences.zh: 这种观念的变化会带来一些严重的金钱后果。”

segments.text: With that mindset change come some serious money consequences."

sentences.en: Kids tend to get stuck in the features and the immediate benefits to them personally, Norris said.
sentences.zh: 诺里斯说，孩子往往会执着于房子的具体特点，以及这些特点眼下能给他们个人带来的好处。

segments.text: Kids tend to get stuck in the features and the immediate benefits to them personally, Norris said.

sentences.en: Parents need to remind their children that their needs and desires may change over time, said Julie Gurner, a real estate analyst with FitSmallBusiness.com.
sentences.zh: FitSmallBusiness.com的房地产分析师朱莉·格纳说，父母需要提醒孩子，他们的需要和愿望会随着时间改变。

segments.text: Parents need to remind their children that their needs and desires may change over time, said Julie Gurner, a real estate analyst with FitSmallBusiness.com.

sentences.en: "Their opinions can change tomorrow," Gurner said.
sentences.zh: 格纳说：“他们的意见明天就可能改变。”

segments.text: "Their opinions can change tomorrow," Gurner said.

sentences.en: "Harsh as it may be to say, that decision should likely not be made contingent on a child's opinions, but rather made for them with great consideration into what home can meet their needs best - and give them an opportunity to customize it a bit and make it their own."
sentences.zh: 格纳说：“这话虽然很残酷，但这项决定很可能不应取决于孩子的意见，而应由父母替他们作出，并充分考虑怎样的家最能满足孩子的需要，同时给他们一点机会去自行定制，并把它变成自己的家。”

segments.text: "Harsh as it may be to say, that decision should likely not be made contingent on a child's opinions, but rather made for them with great consideration into what home can meet their needs best - and give them an opportunity to customize it a bit and make it their own."

sentences.en: This advice is more relevant now than ever before, even as more parents want to embrace the ideas of their children, despite the current housing crunch.
sentences.zh: 尽管当前的住房紧张，越来越多的父母希望接纳孩子的想法，但这条建议如今比以往任何时候都更切合实际。

segments.text: This advice is more relevant now than ever before, even as more parents want to embrace the ideas of their children, despite the current housing crunch.
